# NextGen AI Labs

> AI automation company that builds AI chatbots, voice AI assistants, sales follow-up, CRM automation, business process automation and websites for businesses worldwide. Prices are in USD.

Contact: sales@nextgenailabs.com

## Services

- [AI chatbot development](https://www.nextgenailabs.com/ai-chatbot-development.html): AI chatbot development for your website and WhatsApp. We train a chatbot on your business, connect it to your tools and look after it. See plans and pricing.
- [AI voice assistants](https://www.nextgenailabs.com/ai-voice-assistant.html): AI voice assistants that answer business calls, book appointments and send you a summary, with urgent calls passed to your team. See how it works and pricing.
- [CRM automation](https://www.nextgenailabs.com/crm-automation.html): CRM automation that adds leads for you, sends follow-ups and keeps records up to date. We connect your CRM to your website, email and WhatsApp.
- [Business process automation](https://www.nextgenailabs.com/business-process-automation.html): Business process automation for email, documents, invoices, reports and approvals. We find the repetitive work in your business and automate it with AI.
